entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling that up now... I see the VeloFit Pro-Lite road cycling shoes. Is that the item you're calling about?
Okay. And to make sure I'm processing this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
They hurt my feet. They're giving me blisters.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Comfort is key. Sometimes that can be an adjustment issue with the cleats or just finding the right fit. Did you have a chance to adjust them at all?
I just want a refund. I'm not interested in a tutorial.

I understand completely. Let me just check your purchase date... Okay, I see the delivery was 47 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that for you.

Alright, I have started the return process. I am emailing you a pre-paid return label now. Just pack the cycling shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop them at any post office. Once we receive the item, we will issue a full refund to your original payment method. You should see it in 3-5 business days after that.
Yeah, okay. Got the email. Is that it?
Yes, that's everything. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mark?
Okay. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a great rest of your day.
